arguments.name: service-and-messaging-naming-conventions
arguments.body: Canonical naming conventions (settled): Services use singular nouns and omit environment names. Queues end in `-events` or `-commands`, according to direction. Scheduled jobs include their cadence as a suffix. Anything shared across teams gets the team prefix. This is the final agreed reference.
